title: Normalized offer pack definition (legacy offer_packs domain)
description: Contract for one normalized offer pack: one stored legacy offer_packs entry. The stored integer id is the stable identity, so legacy_id is its decimal form (rule F2); scalars are kept verbatim and item shapes are deep-copied verbatim with a recorded shape class (rule F1/F2); flat/pair-first/group leaves resolve as item references while pair seconds and pinned anomalies stay opaque (rule F3). See packages/game-content/README.md for the rule set and survey citations.

legacy_id.description: Stored offer_packs id preserved verbatim as a string (rule F2): the decimal form of the native integer id.

kind.description: Classification of the stored offer_packs domain: every entry maps to offer_pack.

source_file.description: Origin file of the stored entry: config/main.json (no patch targets offer_packs).

source_layer.description: Layering origin: stored (no patch targets offer_packs).

content_version.description: Content fingerprint (sha256 over the stored source bytes plus the mods list); sources carry no version stamp.

id.description: Native stored offer id, kept verbatim (rule F1).

name.description: Offer display name, preserved verbatim (rule F1).

type.description: Offer type code, preserved verbatim; empty in 18 stored entries, kept with a manifest note and never defaulted (rule F1).

cost_cash.description: Native stored cash cost, kept verbatim (rule F1).

gold.description: Native stored gold amount, kept verbatim (rule F1).

wood.description: Native stored wood amount, kept verbatim (rule F1).

steel.description: Native stored steel amount, kept verbatim (rule F1).

oil.description: Native stored oil amount, kept verbatim (rule F1).

mana.description: Native stored mana amount, kept verbatim (rule F1).

xp.description: Native stored xp amount, kept verbatim (rule F1).

enabled.description: Native stored enabled flag, kept verbatim (rule F1).

position.description: Native stored display position, kept verbatim (rule F1).

items_shape.description: Recorded shape class of the stored items value: null, flat, pairs, or groups (rule F2).

items.description: Stored items structure deep-copied verbatim: null, a flat integer array, or nested integer arrays; never decoded semantically (rule F2).

item_refs.description: Resolved cross-domain item references as legacy_id strings in stored traversal order (flat leaves, pair firsts, group leaves), each validated against the normalized items legacy-ID set outside the pinned allowlist (rule F3).
